story: I'm an AI product manager with an unusual path. I started as a digital transformation consultant, mapping how large enterprises really work and redesigning their workflows.

That habit of asking 'how could this work better?' led me to AI. As a founding member of TCS's OpenAI Centre of Excellence, I moved from improving workflows to building intelligent agentic platforms with humans in the loop.

Studying systems end to end made me curious about a bigger question: what happens when AI agents start acting for everyday people, not just enterprises? That question drives my work today, building agentic products that are useful, trustworthy and human at their core.

contactCopy.intro: The fastest way to reach me is email — or find me on LinkedIn. Whether it's agentic AI, product strategy or a new role, my inbox is open.
